SELECT SEQ_TEAM_MEMBER.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TEAM_MEMBER ( TEAM_MEMBER_NUM, TEAM_NUM, USER_NUM, ROLE, JOIN_STATUS, JOINED_AT ) VALUES ( #{team_member_num}, #{team_num}, #{user_num}, #{role}, 1, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT TM.TEAM_MEMBER_NUM, TM.TEAM_NUM, TM.USER_NUM, TM.ROLE, TM.JOIN_STATUS, TM.JOINED_AT, TM.LAST_ACTIVITY_AT, TM.EXITED_AT, U.USER_NAME, U.EMAIL, U.INTRO, U.PHOTO_NAME FROM TEAM_MEMBER TM JOIN USERS U ON TM.USER_NUM = U.USER_NUM WHERE TM.TEAM_NUM = #{teamNum} AND TM.USER_NUM = #{userNum} AND TM.JOIN_STATUS = 1

SELECT TM.TEAM_MEMBER_NUM, TM.TEAM_NUM, TM.USER_NUM, TM.ROLE, TM.JOIN_STATUS, TM.JOINED_AT, TM.LAST_ACTIVITY_AT, U.USER_NAME, U.EMAIL, U.INTRO, U.PHOTO_NAME, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KANBAN_CARD KC WHERE KC.TEAM_NUM = TM.TEAM_NUM AND KC.WRITER_NUM = TM.USER_NUM AND KC.STATUS != 2) AS CARD_CNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KANBAN_CARD KC WHERE KC.TEAM_NUM = TM.TEAM_NUM AND KC.WRITER_NUM = TM.USER_NUM AND KC.STATUS != 2 AND KC.KANBAN_STATUS = 4) AS DONE_CNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_FILE CF WHERE CF.TEAM_NUM = TM.TEAM_NUM AND CF.UPLOADER_NUM = TM.USER_NUM) AS FILE_CNT FROM TEAM_MEMBER TM JOIN USERS U ON TM.USER_NUM = U.USER_NUM WHERE TM.TEAM_NUM = #{teamNum} AND TM.JOIN_STATUS = 1 ORDER BY TM.ROLE DESC, TM.JOINED_AT ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TEAM_MEMBER WHERE TEAM_NUM = #{teamNum} AND JOIN_STATUS = 1

SELECT T.TEAM_NUM, T.TEAM_NAME, T.DESCRIPTION, T.TEAM_PHOTO, T.TEAM_PHOTO_NAME, T.COLOR, T.STATUS, T.CREATED_AT, T.UPDATED_AT, T.CREATOR_NUM FROM TEAM T JOIN TEAM_MEMBER TM ON T.TEAM_NUM = TM.TEAM_NUM WHERE TM.USER_NUM = #{userNum} AND TM.JOIN_STATUS = 1 AND T.STATUS != 3 ORDER BY TM.JOINED_AT DESC

SELECT TM.TEAM_MEMBER_NUM, TM.TEAM_NUM, TM.USER_NUM, TM.ROLE, TM.JOIN_STATUS, TM.JOINED_AT, TM.LAST_ACTIVITY_AT, TM.EXITED_AT, U.USER_NAME, U.EMAIL, U.INTRO, U.PHOTO_NAME FROM TEAM_MEMBER TM JOIN USERS U ON TM.USER_NUM = U.USER_NUM WHERE TM.TEAM_NUM = #{teamNum} AND TM.USER_NUM = #{userNum}
mapper.update: UPDATE TEAM_MEMBER SET JOIN_STATUS = 1, ROLE = 1, JOINED_AT = SYSDATE, EXITED_AT = NULL WHERE TEAM_NUM = #{teamNum} AND USER_NUM = #{userNum}
mapper.select: SELECT email FROM ( SELECT U.EMAIL AS email FROM USERS U WHERE UPPER(U.EMAIL) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' AND U.STATUS = 1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TEAM_MEMBER TM WHERE TM.TEAM_NUM = #{teamNum} AND TM.USER_NUM = U.USER_NUM AND TM.JOIN_STATUS = 1 ) ORDER BY U.EMAIL ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 10

SELECT TM.TEAM_MEMBER_NUM, TM.TEAM_NUM, TM.USER_NUM, TM.ROLE, TM.JOIN_STATUS, TM.JOINED_AT, TM.LAST_ACTIVITY_AT, U.USER_NAME, U.EMAIL, U.INTRO, U.PHOTO_NAME
FROM TEAM_MEMBER TM JOIN USERS U ON TM.USER_NUM = U.USER_NUM
WHERE TM.TEAM_NUM = #{teamNum} AND TM.JOIN_STATUS = 1 AND TM.ROLE != 3
ORDER BY TM.ROLE DESC, TM.JOINED_AT ASC
